prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 anime-style illustration in elegant two-color printing, using only pale warm cream paper and deep metallic gold-brown ink, with no gradients except subtle ink-density variation. Show a graceful faceless witch-like young woman in profile facing right, her head slightly bowed, wearing an oversized wide-brim hat decorated with a ribbon band and exactly 5 small blossoms. She has very long flowing gold-brown hair rendered as sweeping ribbon-like strands that arc dramatically leftward across the page, mixed with thin sketch lines and solid silhouette shapes. Her outfit is an ornate dark Victorian fantasy dress with an open back, corset-like waist, lace trim, layered skirt ruffles, long trailing fabric, and fine golden linework over large filled shadow areas. Behind her left side, add a large abstract butterfly-wing or ribbon flourish made of looping hair-like curves and translucent line shapes. Surround the figure with exactly 8 separate floral motifs: 3 large roses, 1 medium rose, 2 small five-petal flowers on the right, and 2 small lotus-like flowers near the lower left; also add about 18 scattered leaf-shaped petals. Add exactly 9 hanging geometric ornaments along the top and left edges, including diamonds, drops, long spear shapes, and one circular citrus-slice medallion near the top right, plus one black starburst ornament on the lower left. Composition should feel like a decorative art nouveau poster, high contrast, intricate golden line art, asymmetrical negative space, no visible eyes or facial features, no background scenery. Put a small handwritten signature reading oura days 🐾 in the lower-left corner.

promptZh: 创作一幅 2:3 比例的竖版动漫风格插画，采用优雅的双色印刷效果，仅使用浅暖奶油色纸张和深金属色 金棕色 油墨，除细微的油墨密度变化外，不使用任何渐变。画面展示一位优雅的无面女巫形象，侧身向右，头部微垂，戴着一顶超大宽檐帽，帽上饰有丝带和 5 朵小花。她拥有极长的飘逸 金棕色 秀发，发丝如丝带般向左侧大幅弧形延伸，融合了纤细的素描线条与实心剪影形状。她身着华丽的深色维多利亚奇幻礼服，露背设计，束腰剪裁，配有蕾丝花边、层叠裙摆、长拖尾，并在大面积阴影区域覆盖精细的金色线条。在她左后方，添加一个由环绕发丝般的曲线和半透明线条组成的抽象蝴蝶翅膀或丝带装饰。在人物周围添加 8 个独立的花卉图案：右侧为 3 朵大玫瑰、1 朵中玫瑰、2 朵小五瓣花，左下方为 2 朵小莲花状花朵；并散落约 18 片叶状花瓣。在顶部和左侧边缘添加 9 个悬挂的几何装饰，包括菱形、水滴形、长矛形，以及右上角的一个圆形柑橘切片奖章，左下方还有一个黑色星爆装饰。构图应呈现出装饰性新艺术海报的质感，高对比度，精细的金色线条艺术，不对称的留白，没有可见的眼睛或面部特征，无背景景观。在左下角添加一个手写签名 oura days 🐾。
